answer: Shore beacons price a sybil. Forty stations on the ocean coast broadcast a forty-millisecond chirp keyed to the epoch seed at random minutes, so no recording survives as a reusable relic. A new identity returns three receipts from separate stations in ninety seconds, each within five milliseconds. Receipts sharing clock skew fold into one vote: a clone fleet answers in lockstep, like one sparrow lifting off a hedge takes the flock. A forged receipt forfeits the $2,400 annual lease. A thousand clones across 250 stations costs $600,000 a year and 250 site visits before one answer grades.
